title: Our Day Program is in Full Swing!

content:
Our group day program for adults with developmental disabilities has now been open for two months! Since its opening at the end of December, we have added more people to our program, brought on new staff to support its operations, and created an engaging atmosphere for people to build skills, accomplish their goals, and learn about nature and agriculture.

Opportunities for Community Coaching and Community Engagement are also in the works!

If anyone is interested in learning more about our services, please contact our Director of Applied Practice, Casey Clarke at casey@autismsanctuary.org.
